metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 1977 · Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2009 · Avatar
metas.description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2003 · Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1983 · Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
metas.description: After rescuing Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebel Alliance attempts to destroy the second Death Star while Luke struggles to help Darth Vader back from the dark side.

metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · Thor
metas.description: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1999 · Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
metas.description: Two Jedi escape a hostile blockade to find allies and come across a young boy who may bring balance to the Force, but the long-dormant Sith resurface to claim their former glory.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2005 · Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
metas.description: As the Clone Wars nears its end, Obi-Wan Kenobi pursues a new threat, while Anakin Skywalker is lured by Chancellor Palpatine into a sinister plot for galactic domination.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2016 · Doctor Strange
metas.description: While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2006 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
metas.description: Jack Sparrow races to recover the heart of Davy Jones to avoid enslaving his soul to Jones' service, as other friends and foes seek the heart for their own agenda as well.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2002 · Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
metas.description: Ten years after initially meeting, Anakin Skywalker shares a forbidden romance with Padmé Amidala, while Obi-Wan Kenobi discovers a secret clone army crafted for the Jedi.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2013 · Thor: The Dark World
metas.description: When the Dark Elves attempt to plunge the universe into darkness, Thor must embark on a perilous and personal journey that will reunite him with doctor Jane Foster.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2016 · Suicide Squad
metas.description: A secret government agency recruits some of the most dangerous incarcerated super-villains to form a defensive task force. Their first mission: save the world from the apocalypse.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2007 · Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
metas.description: Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, Hector Barbossa, and the crew of the Black Pearl try and rescue Jack from Davy Jones's locker, and prepare to fight Lord Cutler Beckett, who controls Davy Jones and the Flying Dutchman.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2017 · Wonder Woman
metas.description: When a pilot crashes and tells of conflict in the outside world, Diana, an Amazonian warrior in training, leaves home to fight a war, discovering her full powers and true destiny.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
metas.description: Rey develops her abilities with the help of Luke Skywalker as the Resistance prepares for battle against the First Order.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Avatar: The Way of Water
metas.description: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2011 · Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
metas.description: Jack Sparrow and Barbossa embark on a quest to find the elusive fountain of youth, only to discover that Blackbeard and his daughter are after it too.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2022 · Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2018 · Aquaman
metas.description: Arthur Curry, the human-born heir to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, goes on a quest to prevent a war between the worlds of ocean and land.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2019 · Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker
metas.description: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1999 · The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2021 · Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2010 · Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A young man must defeat his new girlfriend's seven evil exes, who are willing to do anything to prevent her happiness with someone else.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1984 · Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2021 · Eternals
metas.description: The saga of the Eternals, a race of immortal beings who lived on Earth and shaped its history and civilizations.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · Constantine
metas.description: Detective Angela approaches Constantine, a demon hunter, to help her investigate her twin sister's mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he realizes that demons are trying to enter the human world.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2017 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
metas.description: Captain Jack Sparrow searches for the Trident of Poseidon to rule the sea while being pursued by old rival Captain Salazar and a crew of deadly ghosts who have escaped from the Devil's Triangle.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2005 · Fantastic Four
metas.description: A group of astronauts gain superpowers after a cosmic radiation exposure and must use them to oppose the plans of their enemy, Doctor Victor Von Doom.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2017 · Kong: Skull Island
metas.description: After the Vietnam war, a team of scientists explores an uncharted island in the Pacific, venturing into the domain of the mighty Kong and must fight to escape a primal Eden.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2004 · Hellboy
metas.description: A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2001 · The Mummy Returns
metas.description: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1992 · Batman Returns
metas.description: While Batman deals with a deformed man calling himself the Penguin wreaking havoc across Gotham with the help of a cruel businessman, a female employee of the latter becomes the Catwoman with her own vendetta.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2014 · 300: Rise of an Empire
metas.description: Greek general Themistocles of Athens leads the naval charge against invading Persian forces led by mortal-turned-god Xerxes and Artemisia, vengeful commander of the Persian navy.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2010 · Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
metas.description: A young fugitive prince and princess must stop a villain who unknowingly threatens to destroy the world with a special dagger that enables the magic sand inside to reverse time.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2020 · Wonder Woman 1984
metas.description: Wonder Woman finds herself battling two opponents, Maxwell Lord, a shrewd entrepreneur, and Barbara Minerva, a friend-turned-foe. Meanwhile, she also ends up crossing paths with her love interest.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2004 · Van Helsing
metas.description: The famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula, who is using Dr. Frankenstein's research and a werewolf for nefarious purposes.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2022 · Black Adam
metas.description: Nearly 5,000 years after he was bestowed with the almighty powers of the Egyptian gods--and imprisoned just as quickly--Black Adam is freed from his earthly tomb, ready to unleash his unique form of justice on the modern world.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2010 · Clash of the Titans
metas.description: Perseus, a demigod and the son of Zeus, battles the minions of Hades and the Underworld in order to stop them from conquering Olympus and Earth.
